title: Are LLM Assistants Regulatory Ready? Answers from regenold's 2026 EU AI Act Q&A Challenge
reasons: 新基准贡献、任务、评分协议、模型比较及资源线索达到自动筛选门槛；资源内容尚未核实
missingSignals: 给出任务规模或覆盖范围
讨论泛化、污染、稳健性或人工核验

evidence.label: 明确提出新的评测资料或框架
evidence.excerpt: We introduce the EU AI Act Q&A Benchmark, an expert-curated benchmark of 110 open-ended questions about the EU AI Act (Regulation (EU) 2024/1689).

evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Large language model (LLM) assistants are increasingly proposed for regulatory affairs, yet their reliability in regulatory tasks remains unclear.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Evaluation measures answer correctness, reference quality, conciseness, tone, and latency, with a multi-turn ``hard mode'' testing responses to simulated user pushback.

evidence.label: 报告基线或多个模型的评测
evidence.excerpt: We also present the results of the 2026 EU AI Act Q&A Challenge, based on the benchmark, where three off-the-shelf baselines and five purpose-built assistants (from four commercial developers and one academic entrant) were tested.
